records.title: 9 May 1988 revised MJ-12 reference report
records.originalCase: NARA Military Reference Branch, Reference Report on MJ-12
records.question: Did NARA issue a revised report dated 9 May 1988 and change a civil-defence folder date from 1954 to 1956? Where is its official archived copy?
records.sourceWarning: The reference report discusses disputed document provenance. Neither its existence nor the year correction authenticates a purported MJ-12 programme.
records.statusDetail: The outgoing email service confirmed sending. Agency delivery, acknowledgement, response, and official custody of the 1988 revised scan have not been verified. This is an archival-reference question, not a confirmation of the MJ-12 allegation.
records.requestMethod: Email enquiry requesting an archive reference or authenticated digital copy; no paid scan ordered.
records.evidenceRequirement: A reply from NARA identifying the May 1988 revision and an official catalogue entry, original scan or certified copy.
